purpose: Train T One to operate independent commerce sites with a shared catalog-to-profit workflow, platform-specific API boundaries, vertical-specific fulfillment and tax extensions, evidence discipline, and store-isolated write gates.

runtime_contract.selection_rule: Use the existing configured model gateway; probe modality, health, cost, latency, budget, and data boundary at runtime.
runtime_contract.state_rule: Do not store business state in model context; retrieve the minimum tenant/project/store/task slice and write structured facts and evidence back.

webhook.duplicate_policy: same platform and event_id with identical contract is idempotent; changed facts or payload are blocked
webhook.event_order_policy: derive refund and dispute state from occurred_at order rather than delivery order

pim_batch.clear_semantics: action=clear with no value field; empty string and null-as-value are ambiguous and blocked

route_contract.route_label_policy: GLOBAL is a routing label for an independent site, not evidence that tax, privacy, shipping, payment, product, or ad rules are globally uniform.
route_contract.credential_policy: Only credential_ref may enter a task. Tokens, keys, passwords, cookies, MFA material, and payment secrets are forbidden in task payloads and logs.

layers.promotion_rule: Distill only product-independent method; retain product values in their source route.

scope_isolation_contract.unknown_product_policy: When tenant product facts or the current platform category schema are missing, return unknown and perform an authorized dynamic schema read; never inherit another tenant or product fixture.
scope_isolation_contract.scope_leakage_action: Block the response or write, identify the leaking source layer, remove inherited tenant values, and add a regression case before reuse.
scope_isolation_contract.public_distribution_rule: Open-source or multi-tenant builds must exclude private_tenant private product, price, inventory, warehouse, customer, media and contact data.

source_review_state_policy.candidate_screened: Identity and relevance were checked, but the source was not opened deeply and cannot add a fact.
source_review_state_policy.opened_not_reviewed: The source or software opened but did not meet scroll, page, comment or video coverage; it cannot add a fact.
source_review_state_policy.fully_reviewed: The source met the applicable 90 percent scroll, footer, secondary-link, comment or video requirements and can be distilled at its evidence layer.
source_review_state_policy.blocked: Access control, login, CAPTCHA, paywall, runtime failure or another lawful stop condition prevented review; record the gap and do not infer content.

training_evidence_layer_policy.official_current: Current first-party documentation or changelog with capture date, market, store model and applicability.
training_evidence_layer_policy.verified_software_observation: Actual visible software/page input, output, error and permission boundary; it proves only the observed route and state.
training_evidence_layer_policy.multi_source_practice: At least three independent non-official sources agree and the practice remains an experiment with applicability and counterexamples.
training_evidence_layer_policy.single_case: One dated operator, seller, forum, video or task case; never a general rule.
training_evidence_layer_policy.historical_trace: Past action or state retained for audit and regression, not assumed current.
training_evidence_layer_policy.unknown: Missing, blocked, stale, contradictory or unauthorized evidence.

evidence_first_cycle.no_new_evidence_behavior: Return no_new_evidence with the blocking reason and do not create a lesson, rule, connector claim, or evaluation fact.

hard_acceptance.finite_web_page: At least 90 percent rendered scroll coverage, footer or explicit stop reason, navigation/table-of-contents review and one necessary first-party detail page.
hard_acceptance.infinite_scroll: At least three new-load scroll attempts with final stop reason.
hard_acceptance.comments: Pinned/top/latest, author or official replies, disagreement and failures; inspect at least 10 comments or all visible comments when fewer than 10 exist.
hard_acceptance.short_video: For 10 minutes or less, at least 95 percent playback or reliable subtitle coverage plus opening, core-operation and ending visual checks; 0:00 is opened_not_reviewed.
hard_acceptance.work_mix: At least 70 percent Shopify/WooCommerce operating mainline, no more than 20 percent tools or AI, and no more than 10 percent cross-platform reference.

knowledge_package_first_policy.cycle_effort_floor: At least 50 percent of source work must be English package discovery, source audit, reuse and deduplication; generic official introductions may not exceed 10 percent.
knowledge_package_first_policy.admission_rule: Do not clone, install, run, copy or commercially merge an unadmitted, unlicensed, unsafe, stale or credential-risk package. Only the verified delta may enter the existing unique assets.

external_ads_boundary.separation_rule: Store API authorization never grants external advertising authorization.
external_ads_boundary.catalog_rule: A feed, pixel, tag, app, marketing event, or catalog link is not proof of writable ad-account access.

official_sources.verification_note: Official URL retained, but detailed page retrieval failed in this run; no Meta-specific operational rule may be promoted without re-verification.

evidence_contract.documentation_boundary: Official public documentation proves a documented possibility or rule at capture time, not store installation, entitlement, connection, object state, output quality, metric, or completed business action.
evidence_contract.native_ai_boundary: Record entry point, prerequisites, inputs, output, edit/save/submit state, metric, error and recovery. AI output remains draft until source, rights and state transition are verified.
evidence_contract.seller_experience_policy: Seller experience never becomes a standard rule only because multiple sellers repeat it; it remains a dated experiment hypothesis until official or store-result evidence supports it.
evidence_contract.expiration_policy: API versions, scopes, prices, tax, payment, carrier, product eligibility, advertising, and feature-availability claims require a recheck before risky action.
evidence_contract.deep_coverage_stop_rule: Stop after two link layers add no new fact, the topic drifts, content repeats, or login, CAPTCHA, paywall, rate limit, or another access control appears; record the gap and never bypass it.
evidence_contract.source_promotion_rule: Only fully_reviewed evidence can add a platform fact or operating rule. candidate_screened, opened_not_reviewed and blocked sources may add only coverage, failure, duplicate or next-source records.
evidence_contract.finite_web_coverage_rule: Record measured rendered scroll coverage of at least 90 percent, the footer or stop reason, navigation/table of contents and one necessary first-party detail page.
evidence_contract.video_coverage_rule: A 0:00 or cover-only video is opened_not_reviewed. For 10 minutes or less require 95 percent playback or reliable subtitles plus opening, core-operation and ending visual checks; record duration, seconds, subtitle coverage, timestamps and comments.
evidence_contract.cycle_mix_rule: At least 70 percent of evidence work must directly serve Shopify/WooCommerce operating outcomes; tools or AI may not exceed 20 percent and cross-platform references may not exceed 10 percent.
evidence_contract.github_admission_rule: Reverse-verify official identity from the platform site, deduplicate owner/repo plus commit/tag/license/security state, inspect relevant README/docs/releases/license/commits/issues/discussions/PR/security/dependencies/data flows, then defer installation admission to config/github_capability_registry.json ownership.
evidence_contract.knowledge_package_promotion_rule: For one operating gap, compare two or three English-discovered packages, inspect one core workflow, one failure boundary and three rules, then verify time-sensitive differences on current first-party deep pages. Record one allowed verdict; package presence never proves integration.
evidence_contract.knowledge_package_rejection_rule: Unknown or conflicting license, stale maintenance, unsafe credential/telemetry/data flow, raw PII, consent bypass, missing security posture or absent shared admission blocks installation and code reuse.
evidence_contract.comment_learning_rule: Comments are formal evidence inputs but remain community_signal or dated_operator_case unless an author/official reply and current official source independently support the claim. Anonymize summaries, do not retain personal identifiers, and never promote votes, repetition, promotion, suspected automation or AI-like text into platform truth.
